claims.text: Clusters were extracted using the k-means algorithm initialized with 'k-means++' and run for 300 iterations.
The effectiveness of cluster membership features was demonstrated in various tasks, indicating their role in the feature extraction process.
The selection of word vectors and the number of clusters is described as a trial-and-error procedure.
